environment: Node VM + mocked React hooks, Image, DOM, requestAnimationFrame, localStorage, HTMLAudioElement, AudioContext, controlled timeout timers and renderWorld; no real browser or audible playback

media decoding error disables the score and continues silent animation
scene switch uses only the configured score; ungenerated scenes remain explicitly silent
returning to shadow may resume a previously user-enabled score from its opening
background visibility pauses the score and stage clock
foreground visibility resumes a playing score

leaving reduced mode does not resume sound automatically
ended music settles at final tableau with zero bands
playlist begins in gravity without leaking the shadow soundtrack
playlist keeps gravity finale for at least 3.5 seconds
late collection dialogue finishes before the next playlist scene

resuming a truly ended playlist finale never calls play or rewinds the media

continuous pointer movement does not reset action age and the gesture reaches idle

checks.label: visual performance advances again after preparing music times out
a timed out playback promise cannot revive old sound when it eventually resolves
waiting without media progress also falls back after fifteen seconds
repeated waiting or stalled events cannot extend a fifteen second no-progress deadline
real playback recovery clears the previous waiting deadline
source load resets old media position and reuses the single audio graph
stale old play completion cannot revive the shadow score over the new garden score
entering plant selection cancels playlist and pauses visual and available musical clocks
a planted discovery completes its independent feedback while the stable show remains paused
arming a planting location neither collects nor changes the show time
Escape cancels planting mode without leaving a plot
plant location preview does not save before pointer release
pointer release plants one saved location during the final act
keyboard Enter commits a planting location and exits selection
garden keeps only the most recent four valid saved positions
out of bounds clicks are clamped into the actual garden planting safe area
reloading restores the actual four planted positions rather than only a count
legacy count-only records remain usable with three safe fallback plots
malformed garden records are filtered or safely clamped without breaking the host
planting inversely projects the visible pointer through camera zoom and pan
cancelled pointer selection never commits an extra plant
scene switching cancels location selection while preserving saved plants

limitations: Browser autoplay policy, physical sound output, real decoder timing, fonts/layout, pointer routing, Canvas imagery and persistence across real reloads are not verified by these mocks.
Real media existence, MP3 decoding, non-silence and generation provenance are recorded separately in notes/world-music-generation-v9.json and subsequent music generation records.
Ended playback, metadata loading, source load and timeout behavior are modeled explicitly; these checks still do not constitute browser media validation.
